name: Lady Wachter's Book Club
summary: Lady Fiona Wachter wants the Baron's chair, and she is not shy about who she would rule for.

stages.journal: Lady Fiona Wachter's book club meets late and reads nothing. The Baron is sure she is plotting against him. He may even be right.
stages.hint: Pay Lady Wachter a call at Wachterhaus in Vallaki.

stages.journal: Lady Wachter told us plainly that she means to unseat the Baron at the festival, and that she would like our help. She would like it very much.
objectives: Decide whether to stand with her
stages.hint: Pledge to Lady Wachter at Wachterhaus, or look into her cellar's reading circle first.

stages.journal: Beneath Wachterhaus we found a shrine to the lord of Barovia and a letter in his hand, thanking Lady Wachter for her loyalty. Whoever reads it will know what she is.
objectives: Decide who should see the letter
stages.hint: The letter has been read. Go to the Festival of the Blazing Sun in Vallaki's square and see what Lady Wachter does.

stages.journal: We broke up the midnight circle in Lady Wachter's cellar. Her sons and her hired swords are finished, whatever she still plans.
stages.hint: Go to the Festival of the Blazing Sun in Vallaki's square and see what Lady Wachter still tries.

stages.journal: We pledged ourselves to Lady Wachter's cause. She wants the Baron's wicker sun to fail, and us beside her when it does.
stages.hint: Ask the festival herald in Vallaki's square to begin, and stand with Lady Wachter when she speaks.

stages.journal: Lady Wachter's coup failed at the festival. She has been dragged to the Baron's stocks to wait for his justice.
Lady Wachter's coup succeeded. She sits in the burgomaster's chair, and Vallaki belongs to her and, through her, to someone else.
Lady Wachter's devotion to the lord of Barovia was read out before the whole town. The new council has locked her in the Baron's lockup.
Lady Wachter lost her chance at the festival, but nobody could prove what she is. She has gone home to Wachterhaus to wait for another.
stages.hint: Lady Wachter is back at Wachterhaus. Nobody can prove what she is, so there's nothing more to do for now.
